estimatedAlbedo.test: Grav et al. (2015), Table 3, measured the two small irregular moons of Saturn NEOWISE detected: Albiorix 6.2 ± 2.8% and Siarnaq 5.0 ± 1.7%. Its eleven irregular moons of Jupiter range from 2.9% to 5.7%.
